name: ai-studio
description: Dreambel Tech's agent skills and Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: studio-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in the ai-studio skills folder, as Claude Code skills: intent-first work, meaning-first design, delivery with evidence, code coherence, React SCSS architecture, session relay and session cleanup.

plugins.name: intent-first-work
plugins.description: The intent-first-work skill and its instruction lines, given to each session at start, so every task starts from the intention and the existing state and ends with a check against the intention. Nothing is written to your projects or instruction files.

plugins.name: agent-skills-bridge
plugins.description: Makes the skills in a project's .agents/skills folder available in Claude Code by linking .claude/skills to it at session start.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Tells the session once per level when its context grows heavy, so it can offer a fresh session from a relay brief at the next natural break.

plugins.name: session-cleanup
plugins.description: Gives each session the path of its history and the command that lists what it left (worktrees, merged branches, browser profiles, copied env files), with sizes, so it can offer a cleanup at the end of each unit of work.
